text:
theo: Noticed a spike of 413s hitting /v1/embeddings when clients upload ~28k-dim arrays in one batch. Router is rejecting at ingress preflight.

priya: Is preflight still doing strict max_bytes check? We used to try splitting after preflight but reverted the path because of billing double-count concerns.

dan: Correct, preflight bails on > max_payload_bytes today. Proposal: introduce an 'adaptive_shard' accept-path where ingress returns 202 and queues a sharder that emits shards within grace_ms. If shardization fails, return 413 to the client.

emma: For SDK ergonomics, prefer returning 202 + header `X-Embed-Estimate: {units}` and a `retry-after` when we need client retry semantics. Mobile clients can poll or websocket notify.

theo: Sketch config for router policy below. This is intentionally conservative (small grace window + shard cap):

```json
{
  "name": "adaptive_shard",
  "grace_ms": 150,
  "max_shards": 6,
  "prefer_dim_split": true,
  "fallback_pool": "cpu-lowfi-ephemeral"
}
```

priya: Console/FF implications: add `embed_adaptive_split_v2` flag and a UI toggle with rollout percent + tenant allowlist. We should also show a per-tenant metric: adaptive_shard_budget_remaining (soft bytes).

dan: Telemetry we need (naming intentionally dotted for dashboards):
- embed.adaptive.attempt (tags: tenant_id, orig_dims, orig_bytes)
- embed.adaptive.success (tags: tenant_id, shard_count, final_bytes)
- embed.adaptive.failure (tags: tenant_id, error_kind)
- embed.adaptive.fallback (tags: tenant_id, fallback_pool)

emma: Also emit gauges/counters: embed.adaptive.inflight, embed.adaptive.throttle_reject, embed.adaptive.bytes_saved_total. Add histogram for embed.adaptive.latency_ms.

priya: UX: new dashboard tile "Adaptive embed shard events" under Usage -> Embeddings. Small explainer: "Router can split oversize requests into shards to avoid client 413s. This may change latency and cost." Link to examples + scrubbed payloads.

dan: Important runtime note: KV cache keys must be canonicalized across shards. We need a deterministic `parent_prefix` that every shard derives so cache lookups for prefixes still hit. Otherwise we risk quality regressions.

theo: Agree. We'll expose `split_prefix` and keep original text->prefix hashing unchanged. Also add `split_walk_id` and `parent_request_id` to traces so we correlate shards.

emma: Billing flow: emit a `billing.embed.parent` event with estimated units at acceptance, and a reconciliation `billing.embed.final` when shards complete. Console should show an "Expected cost impact" when toggling the FF.

priya: Safety: per-tenant soft quota `embed_soft_quota_bytes` (defaults to 1MB/day) — if exceeded, router falls back to strict preflight and returns 413. Prevents abuse from noisy tenants.

dan: On split error conditions: if splitter returns transient error, retry once within grace_ms, then fallback to fallback_pool. If fallback_pool is unavailable, return 413. Telemetry should mark these as `error_kind=split_timeout` or `error_kind=no_fallback`.

theo: Rollout plan suggestion: 0.5% tenants -> monitor embed.adaptive.failure and embed.adaptive.fallback for 12h, then 5% for 24h, then 25% for 48h, full rollout after a week if metrics stable. Auto-rollback if failure_rate > 0.5% or p95 latency increases > 25%.

emma: Console: add alert rules created by default when FF enabled: (1) adaptive.failure_rate > 0.2% over 5m, (2) adaptive.fallback_rate spike > x, (3) p95 route latency +20% vs baseline. We'll surface these under the feature flag page.

priya: Small API contract change: on 202 responses we must still return consistent body shape. Suggest returning { "status": "accepted", "parent_request_id": "...", "estimate_units": 12345 }. Keep error codes unchanged for 4xx/5xx.

dan: Implementation checklist: idempotent shard creation, single billing reconciliation, canonical cache key, instrumentation, trace ids, FF gate, soft-quota lookup. Also add unit test for mixed-dim arrays (10k + 18k dims) to ensure split_by_dims path works.

emma: I'll mock the console tile and flag UI (dashboard draft: https://console.redwood.dev/dashboards/embeddings/adaptive-shard — placeholder).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag `embed_adaptive_split_v2` canary rollout started to 0.5% tenants (deploy id: dpl-2026-03-21-07).

priya: Assignments: theo + dan will implement runtime & KV prefix; emma + ops to do console + alerts; i will write the FF proposal + rollout doc.

theo: Cool, i'll open the PRs and link the implementation plan. Keep an eye on billing reconciliation telemetry.

emma: ping me before canary so I can enable dashboard dashboards and alerting automation.

ops-bot: note: monitoring team copied — will watch adaptive.* metrics during canary.

theo: thanks — will update thread with first canary telemetry in ~30m.
